title: Sync Offline Changes Automatically
description: As a Mobile App User, I want my data modifications made while offline to automatically synchronize with the server when connectivity is restored, so that I can use the app seamlessly in spotty network conditions without data loss.
business_value: Ensures high data integrity and user retention by providing a resilient, frustration-free experience regardless of network status, a key competitive differentiator.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"User makes changes offline and reconnects","given":"The user is logged in but has no internet connection","when":"The user modifies library items (adds/edits/deletes) and subsequently restores network connectivity","then":"The app automatically detects the connection, pushes the queued changes to the backend, and resolves conflicts using a 'Last Write Wins' strategy."},{"scenario":"Conflict resolution during sync","given":"A record has been modified on the server while the user modified the same record offline","when":"The offline sync process initiates","then":"The system compares timestamps and applies the most recent change, logging the conflict resolution for debug purposes."},{"scenario":"App restart with pending changes","given":"The user has pending offline changes","when":"The user closes and restarts the application","then":"The pending changes persist in the local Isar database and synchronization resumes automatically."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-002: Implement Offline Synchronization Engine (Isar + Dio)","Implement queue-based mutation tracking","Configure exponential backoff retry policy"]
definition_of_done: ["Isar database schema defined for offline mutations","Sync service handles network toggle scenarios gracefully","Unit tests for 'Last Write Wins' logic pass","Integration tests verify data persistence across app restarts"]

technical_tasks: ["WI-AI-001: Implement User Context Embedding Job","WI-AI-002: Develop Recommendation Generation Service (RAG)","Configure OpenSearch k-NN index","Implement Hangfire job for batch processing"]
definition_of_done: ["Vector embedding pipeline is operational","OpenSearch queries return relevant context","GPT-4 integration parses JSON responses correctly","Latency meets the <5s requirement for async jobs"]

title: Immutable Security Audit Log
description: As a Compliance Officer, I want critical system events (logins, data deletions, subscription changes) to be recorded in an immutable audit trail, so that we can ensure accountability and comply with GDPR regulations.
business_value: Mitigates legal and security risks by ensuring a tamper-proof record of all sensitive actions, satisfying regulatory requirements.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Log sensitive user action","given":"A user performs a sensitive action like 'Delete Account'","when":"The action is committed","then":"An audit event is published to SQS, processed by Lambda, and written to an S3 bucket with Object Lock enabled."},{"scenario":"Verify immutability","given":"An audit log exists in S3","when":"An attempt is made to overwrite or delete the log before the retention period","then":"The S3 Object Lock prevents the modification/deletion."},{"scenario":"Async processing","given":"High load on the API","when":"Audit logs are generated","then":"The main API latency is unaffected because audit logging is decoupled via SQS."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-INFRA-003: Configure Immutable Audit Trail (S3 + Object Lock)","Implement SQS -> Lambda pipeline","Define audit log JSON schema","Integrate audit event dispatch in backend modules"]
definition_of_done: ["S3 Bucket Object Lock is active in Compliance mode","Lambda processes events correctly","Infrastructure deployed via CDK","Penetration test verifies log integrity"]
